assumptions: Mantine emit is applied to ALL candidate sites (denial depends on the emitted class); the sample is drawn from the denied ones.

Arbitrary text sizes: [Nem] = N*16 px; %, vh, vw, calc/clamp/min/max and other [length:..] are unclear (px null, counts as need); colours, var(..) and [length:var(..)] text-[..] (token references) are ignored.
Spacing: fractions (w-1/2) and any spacing class with a /modifier are outside the namespace; keyword values are outside; arbitrary [..] and (--x) are denied, including on max-w/max-h.
F5P counts every padding class token with a numeric, px, arbitrary or (--x) value as a padding-form site, allowed steps included; the rubric then judges its px.
Negative spacing is judged on its magnitude.
offStepPct = share of sampled sites whose reason is not equals-allowed.
Mantine candidate props apply to every JSX element; Mantine string values without a unit are read as px.
S2 runs on source text only (Mantine emitted classes are not part of S2); hex-like strings such as "#add" count as colour literals unless a stated FP predicate applies.
Measured forms: 54 of the 59 the concept books (5 not measurable standalone).
rubric: A denied site is "genuine need" iff its px value equals NO allowed value and the nearest allowed step is MORE than one rung away; otherwise "no need"; px = null ("unclear") counts as need. Allowed values: spacing = multiples of 4 plus 2,6,10,14; type {11,12,13,15,16,18,30}; weight {400,500,600}. For v not allowed: lo/hi = adjacent allowed neighbours, dist = distance to the nearer one, rung = hi-lo of those neighbours. Inside the ladder dist <= rung/2 so it is never over one rung (no need). Beyond an end of a bounded ladder (type <11 or >30, weight <400 or >600): rung = gap of the two outermost steps on that side (type low 11->12 = 1, type high 18->30 = 12, weight 100 both ends); need iff dist > rung. Spacing is unbounded above and floors at 0. Reason per site: equals-allowed | within-rung | beyond-end | unclear.
